title: Continue your ChatGPT experience beyond WhatsApp
summary: ChatGPT will no longer be available on WhatsApp after January 15, 2026. Learn how to link your ChatGPT account and continue your conversations across devices.
body: ChatGPT will no longer be available on WhatsApp after January 15, 2026. Learn how to link your ChatGPT account and continue your conversations across devices.
summaryZh: OpenAI通知用户ChatGPT将在2026年1月15日后不再支持WhatsApp渠道。官方建议用户关联账号以在其他多端设备上继续同步和使用服务。
